author: MrDandS97
body:
Hey guys, I am looking for a team to play.

- I am a 17 years old guy who love pvp, I dont have a lot of experience on the Avicus network but I have been playing Overcast for 2 years (playing 7 tournaments)

- I can speak English, Spanish and a little bit of French

- I can play any position but I enjoy playing as a rusher

- I have mumble, teamspeak and skype (dands.minecraft)

Thanks for reading :P
